entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • OpenAPI: nullable enum parameter with a default value throws InvalidCastException #69864
  • OpenAPI: record constructor default is written to the shared enum component instead of the $ref #69862
  • Backport #61316 (ParseHeaders throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when CR is the last byte of a pipe segment) to release/8.0 and release/9.0 #69858
  • Kestrel accepts HTTP/1.1 request lines with no space before the version and silently rewrites the target (regression in #51535) #69857
  • Quarantine Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel.Core.Tests.Http2KeepAliveTests.TimeoutExceeded_ConnectionFlowControlUsedUpThenPings_NoGoAway #69853
  • `RedisOutputCacheStore` garbage collection loop ignores disposal, keeping disposed hosts reachable for ~5 minutes #69849
  • Request new buffer in `Utf8BufferTextWriter.Flush` implementation #69847
  • Revise `AccessFailedCount` handling #69846
    .NET 12 Planning
  • [API Proposal] Add the Cookie Store API to the typed browser platform APIs for Blazor #69844
    .NET 12 Planning

Closed

  • Error On Building Blazor_WASM Project: mnMicrosoft.NET.Sdk.WebAssembly.Browser.targets #69571
    .NET 12 Planning
  • Cookie TempData fails on non-streaming SSR EditForm redirect with legacy navigation behavior #68796
    11.0-rc2
  • ErrorBoundary doesn't catch exceptions from event handlers whose receiver isn't a component #69770
